universal-3-5-pro.description: Universal-3.5 Pro — flagship multilingual transcription with diarization
universal-3-5-pro.pricingNotes: AssemblyAI lists Universal-3.5 Pro transcription at $0.15/hour and speaker diarization at $0.08/hour, for a diarization-inclusive effective rate of $0.23/hour. Billing is per second. The timing estimate is provisionally reused from Universal-3 Pro until an explicitly approved calibration run is available. Free allowance, volume discounts, enterprise pricing, taxes, and provider credits are ignored.

limits.notes: AssemblyAI allows larger remote URLs than upload API submissions. The current CLI uploads first, so effectiveBytes tracks the smaller upload cap.
